subject: Request: Privileged account snapshots + session log slices for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Jenny Liu <jenny.liu@medcare.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: MedCare IT Audit <it-audit@medcare.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Privileged account snapshots + session log slices for SOC 2 review

Hi Karthik / Neha,

As part of our SOC 2 Type II supplement review for MedCare Health (scope period: 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-31), we need a few specific artifacts beyond the report. Can you provide the following by Friday 2027-06-25 EOD (we can extend if needed):

- Privileged account snapshot for the audit window (list of accounts with admin/owner roles across infra and prod services). CSV preferred.
- Admin session log slices covering successful interactive sessions and console/API sessions for accounts in the snapshot (UTC timestamps). NDJSON or CSV ok.
- Evidence of MFA enforcement for privileged accounts (policy config + representative enforcement logs).
- Records of any JIT (just-in-time) role grants or temporary elevation events during the window.
- Bridge letter confirming whether any control exceptions occurred affecting privileged access during the period, and remediation steps if applicable.

Notes: we can accept hashed user identifiers (SHA-256) instead of email addresses for privacy, but please include a separate mapping file for internal use (not shared). Also let us know if any items require a separate access request (e.g., raw VPC flow logs).

Thanks — we want to close the supplementary artifacts this week so our audit team can reconcile items against the SOC 2 assertion.

Jenny Liu
Senior IT Auditor
MedCare Health — Third-Party Risk

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jenny Liu <jenny.liu@medcare.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged account snapshots + session log slices for SOC 2 review

Thanks Jenny — appreciate the specificity. Looping in Neha (Security) and Laura (Legal) to confirm scope and delivery cadence.

Quick answers / plan:
- We can produce a privileged_account_snapshot.csv and an admin_session_log_slice.ndjson for the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-31.
- MFA enforcement reporting: we can export policy configuration and a sampled enforcement log (we'll label it mfa_enforcement_report.pdf).
- JIT elevation records: Redwood uses temporary role grants for a limited set of ops tooling; we can include a time-bound extract of elevation events.
- Bridge letter: we will draft a redacted bridge letter that confirms control continuity; Laura will advise on wording/limitations.

Clarification needed:
1) Is SHA-256 hashing acceptable for user identifiers? We prefer hashing for external delivery.
2) For session logs, do you need full raw token traces or just session start/stop and IP + user agent? Full token traces include sensitive tokens and will require a separate sanitized extract.

Targeting delivery for the set above on 2027-06-25 EOD. If you need earlier delivery on any single item (e.g., just the snapshot) let me know and we can prioritize.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jenny Liu <jenny.liu@medcare.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Privileged account snapshots + session log slices for SOC 2 review

Hi Jenny — thanks for the clear list. A few technical notes from Security on what we can/should deliver and how it will be redacted:

What we will provide (deliverable names below):
- privileged_account_snapshot.csv — fields: hashed_user_id (sha256), role_name, resource_scope, created_at, last_seen_at, provisioned_by, notes
- admin_session_log_slice.ndjson — event_type, hashed_user_id, session_id, start_time_utc, end_time_utc, source_ip, user_agent, action_summary
- mfa_enforcement_report.pdf — includes exported policy config for our identity provider and enforcement counts for the window
- elevation_events.csv — timeboxed temporary grants (grant_id, hashed_user_id, role, granted_at, revoked_at, approver_id)
- redacted-bridge-letter-draft.pdf — initial draft with attestations and known exceptions (if any)

Constraints / caveats:
- We can hash user identifiers with SHA-256. We will NOT provide the internal mapping file to external parties; per our policy the mapping is for internal use only. If MedCare requires original usernames for mapping to their records, we can coordinate a secure on-site or air-gapped review under an NDA-addendum.
- Raw token traces or secrets are never disclosed. If you need deeper telemetry (e.g., raw VM agent logs), that will need a separate scoped request.
- Logs are exported in UTC and will include timezone offsets in the session metadata where applicable.

Requesting confirmation on two items so we can finalize the extracts:
A) Confirm that hashed_user_id (SHA-256) is acceptable.
B) Confirm minimal fields for admin_session_log_slice (we recommend excluding detailed request payloads and including only start/stop, source_ip, user_agent, actions summary).

We will plan to upload the artifacts to a secure Drive link and deliver a signed bridge letter draft for review by 2027-06-25 EOD.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, InfoSec | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

---
From: Jenny Liu <jenny.liu@medcare.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: MedCare IT Audit <it-audit@medcare.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 16:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privileged account snapshots + session log slices for SOC 2 review

Neha / Karthik — thanks, that level of detail is perfect and the proposed redaction approach is acceptable. Confirming:

- SHA-256 hashed_user_id is acceptable for delivery to MedCare.
- admin_session_log_slice fields as you recommended are sufficient.
- We accept the bridge letter draft; MedCare legal will review wording for attestation scope and may request a minor edit.

Please proceed with delivery to the secure Drive link and add a short README that documents the field definitions and the hashing algorithm used. For the bridge letter we prefer DocuSign for signatures (we will circulate once we receive the draft).

If any item will slip past 2027-06-25 EOD, flag the specific file and ETA. Otherwise we will expect the bundle and will schedule a short follow-up call (15m) next week if needed.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Jenny Liu
Senior IT Auditor
MedCare Health

---
